summary: Verified the MergeWilliamsAccountsCard UI + EmailProviderAuditCard UI after the email-key cleanup. Backend pytest (6/6 PASS) confirms /api/admin/email-providers/audit returns summary {configured_keys:2, in_active_chain:2, safe_to_remove:0} with mailgun=primary + mailtrap=fallback, and /api/admin/merge-williams/{preview,commit} are admin-gated + idempotent (already_merged:true). Frontend Playwright run confirms both cards render on the Settings tab with the expected green 'clean up' and 'Already merged' states; merge-williams-start is correctly absent; refresh button re-fetches the plan without breaking the merged state.

issues: The review request expected the summary as inline text 'Active in chain: 2 · Safe to remove: 0', but the implementation renders three separate stat tiles (KEYS CONFIGURED 2 / ACTIVE IN CHAIN 2 / SAFE TO REMOVE 0). Values are correct; only the presentation differs. No action needed unless main agent specifically wants the inline string.

console_warnings: Two 403 errors observed on initial /admin/dashboard load (unrelated admin endpoints; do not affect the Settings tab cards). Worth a follow-up sweep but non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: merge_williams.py commit endpoint is well-structured: idempotent via already_merged flag, refuses to delete community_user with downstream activity (409), logs each step. Safe to leave deployed.
Email audit summary correctly recomputes from env state at request time, so removing keys from /app/backend/.env immediately reflects in the UI without a deploy.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only verification on preview DB (already-merged state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter72_merge_audit.py covers all four endpoints (audit + merge-preview + merge-commit, both authed and anonymous). Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter72_merge_audit.py -v. The 'already_merged' assertions depend on preview DB state remaining merged — if a future test un-merges, those two tests will fail and need adjustment. UI testids verified live: email-provider-audit-card, email-audit-clean, merge-williams-card, merge-williams-already, merge-williams-refresh; merge-williams-start correctly absent in merged state.
